summary: Full e2e test of Agency Accounts feature (backend + frontend). 8/9 pytest backend tests pass (1 skipped due to indep dashboard endpoint shape). All 8 UI flows verified: agency roster shows Anna(Paris)+Bella(Berlin) with Edit/Delete/Add-profile, stat strip=2, scoped subscription banner links to /subscribe?provider_id=<id>, per-profile messages inbox (Anna=1 'Client X', Bella=0), Add-profile navigates to /dashboard/profile/new, Edit navigates to /dashboard/profile/<pid>, back-to-agency-btn returns to roster, delete removes only that row and agency stays logged in, fresh agency register lands on empty AgencyDashboard, independent provider still lands on single-profile ProviderDashboard with no agency table/back-btn/add-btn and cannot create second profile (400).

issues: React hydration warning: <span x-excluded style='display:contents'> wrapper inserted by external dev-tool instrumentation between <tbody> and <tr>. Warning only, does not affect functionality but may cause hydration mismatch in stricter React modes.

critical_code_review_comments: ProviderDashboard.js is ~2735 lines. Consider splitting into modules (banner, messages, invoices, verification, edit forms) for maintainability.
AgencyDashboard.js is clean and well-scoped (~240 lines) with proper data-testid coverage.
Backend _resolve_owned_profile helper correctly gates ownership; provider_id query-param pattern is consistent across subscriptions/enquiries/invoices/verification.
POST /api/providers/profile correctly restricts multi-profile creation to account_type=='agency' (independent returns 400).
seed_data_creation: Created a couple of throwaway agency accounts and 2 disposable profiles under one of them for the delete flow test (test_delete_1788426345@test.com). One profile was deleted, one remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses httpOnly session_token cookie (not Bearer). Use requests.Session() with credentials=include for API tests. All specified data-testids are present. AgencyDashboard renders when user.account_type==='agency'; independent path unchanged.
